open_linear_question.reason: The terminal preserved only six M32 candidate timings. It omitted every same-input BF16 baseline, all M3679 and M384 rows, and all cosine/NRMSE comparisons, so it cannot decide the independently bound dynamic-E4M3 CUTLASS linear mechanism.

open_linear_question.units: M32 is one concurrent B32 invocation: retain raw batch latency and divide endpoint-batch contribution by 32 requests. M3679 is one request unless the executed consumer proves otherwise. M384 is path-binding evidence and is not charged to the ordinary c32 aggregate.

requirements: Use the pinned vLLM CUTLASS scaled-mm consumer for the candidate; torch._scaled_mm is forbidden.

Run the numerical oracle before timing and persist finiteness, nonzero, cosine, normalized RMSE, and maximum absolute error per row.
Time 8 warmups and 40 samples per arm with allocation, quantization, planning, first call, and JIT excluded.
Atomically persist each completed family/M pair before entering the next row so a later defect cannot erase valid evidence.

disposition.positive: Persist the complete paired numerical and timing table, the corrected request-normalized aggregate, and release available for director endpoint-integration selection.
disposition.decision_bearing_negative: Persist the complete table and first failed numerical or economic gate, close only dynamic-E4M3 CUTLASS linears, and release available by 22:08Z.
disposition.incomplete: Retain only under a live same-claim repair owner while a measured repair plus terminal and safe release fit before the watchdog.
disposition.unsafe_or_unreachable: Release maintenance with the typed guest diagnostic.
